section: Section Two — The Chain of Tradition: the Pairs
subtitle: The Great Assembly, the five Zugot, and the sources of halakhic disagreement
author: Moses Maimonides
intro: Rambam's general introduction to his Commentary on the Mishnah — tracing the oral tradition from Sinai through the Zugot, Rebbi's compilation of the Mishnah, the Talmud and Geonim, and his own methodology. Original 12th-century Judeo-Arabic with English translation.

The Talmud frequently has "Rabbi So-and-so decreed on account of this-and-that, and Rabbi So-and-so did not decree"; this too is one of the causes of disagreement.
